dataset: SWE-bench Verified Mini dev10 (seed=42, 5 django + 5 sphinx)

conditions.Simproved: S with lenient arg routing + exact-then-fuzzy matching in dispatch

findings: All three score 5/10, but solved problems differ (not a tie in substance).
S/S solved django-12774 which baseline lost to TimeExceeded (search cuts exploration time).
S' additionally solved sphinx-7757 once tool-call argument errors were fixed (15%->1%).
S-family lost two easy problems baseline solved (11790, 10673): forcing tools can disrupt a working bash flow.
line-number read fallback stays at 34% even in S (not an argument issue; a prompting/policy issue).
10 tasks x 1 run is too small to tell the +/-2 movement from noise; needs 5 repeats and full 50-task Verified Mini.
